identity.bio: A fictional contemporary Nigerian landscape architect who maps public play spaces and volunteers as a futsal coach. Amara is precise, warm and direct. One individual, not a generalized cultural portrait.

classification: project guardrails and measured targets; not platform hard limits or device performance claims
notes: Limits are project estimates informed by the existing character asset budget; they are not Android hardware guarantees.
Confirm imported memory, frame time, thermal behavior and art quality on representative mid-range Android devices before release.
The four authored base-colour images are embedded in the GLB; metallic and roughness are set in the PBR materials.
Measured output values and GLB SHA-256 are validated by AdditionalCharacterRosterValidation.gd and Blender rebuild checks.
